description: feature-compose.ts appendComposeLesson's failure-recording branch (around :3124-3127) POSTs {type:conceptSearch, source_type:compose_lesson, query:cls} to ${CONCEPT_DB_ENDPOINT}/impulses/resolve with X-Api-Key - and concept-db serves no such route: measured 2026-09-20, HTTP 404 body {"error":"Not found","path":"/impulses/resolve"} (48 bytes) for BOTH a known-present class (typecheck_dangling_reference) and a fresh one. The correct routes are /concepts/search (GET) or /v2/impulses/resolve with an {impulse:{pointer:{...}}} envelope, both verified returning results for the same query. Consequence: the loop that records which lessons were loaded when a compose subsequently FAILED never executes, so lesson relevance/success counters never receive negative signal - a misleading lesson stays ranked forever. This is the identical wrong-hostname-silent-mirror class the long comment at :3224 documents fixing for the MINT path; the failure-credit sibling was left on the dead address. Falsifier: after the fix, a compose failure with lessons loaded must produce a concept usage/failure record (observable via concept_usage_stats or the concept row's metrics changing).
